description: Source code implementing high-level logic for saving and reading configuration data to/from internal flash memory in an engine control system.

methods.name: flashStateCrc
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksum of the persistent configuration state.

methods.name: setNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Schedules a configuration write and sets a flag indicating pending write.

methods.name: getNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Returns whether a configuration write is pending.

methods.name: writeToFlashIfPending
methods.description: Performs flash write if a pending write is scheduled.

methods.name: writeToFlashNow
methods.description: Immediately writes configuration data to flash memory.

methods.name: isValidCrc
methods.description: Checks if the CRC of the configuration state is valid.

methods.name: doResetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets configuration to default based on engine type.

methods.name: doReadConfiguration
methods.description: Reads configuration from specified flash address and validates CRC and version.

methods.name: readConfiguration
methods.description: Reads configuration from primary and secondary flash copies, validates, and applies it.

methods.name: readFromFlash
methods.description: Reads configuration and handles errors, resetting if necessary.

methods.name: rewriteConfig
methods.description: Resets and rewrites configuration to flash.

methods.name: initFlash
methods.description: Initializes flash subsystem and registers console commands.
